The battle lines are drawn...it is time for the final conflict!|X1|}} A '''battle''' occurred on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[X1]] [[X1's faction|faction]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]-turned [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]] led soldiers against his brother, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] X1 to destroy his laboratory of insane [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. The New Republic troops defeated the Imperials on the planet, and X2 killed his brother. ==Prelude== {{Quote|As his brother, it was my sworn duty to stop him.|X2|}} X2 and [[Grey Squadron]] had tracked X1 to [[Bast Castle]] on Vjun and had [[Battle of Vjun|infiltrated]] the fortress. X1 escaped to his [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] laboratory on Mustafar, but by finding a [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]], X2 was able to track his brother. X2 and Grey Squadron traveled to the fiery world in order to find him and bring him to justice. ==The battle== {{Quote|Skywalker went ahead, but somehow X1 managed to capture him.|Shara|}} [[File:X1X2_Duel-over-Mustafar.jpg|thumb|left|200px|X1 and X2 duel in a Star destroyer over the planet.]] The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces attacked the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Remnant's]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fleet in search of the captured [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Soldiers then boarded the Star Destroyer and after fighting off resistance, destroyed it and preceded to the planet surface. X2 then landed on the planet with the support of Republic soldiers. They were attacked by a group of stormtroopers and other forces, including those of [[Gizor Dellso]]'s [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|Rebellion]], while above them X-wings and TIE fighters were still fighting. X1 was using his clone facility on the planet to try and make a clone of Skywalker, and released his clones of Wookiees to try and hold off X2. ==Brother against brother== {{Quote|You…have…won.''"
"''I won't kill you brother.|The final words between X1 and X2|}} X2 saw X1, and they exchanged a few words. X1 now looked similar to the Emperor, Palpatine. X2 got the upper hand in the duel and had a chance to kill his brother. However, he refused to kill him, saying the prisons on Kessel will hold the pieces. X1, using a Force pull, tried to impale X2 with his lightsaber. X2 jumped over the blow and X1 impaled himself, before falling into the lava of the planet's surface. ==Aftermath== [[File:X1_close-up.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The defeated [[X1]]]] {{Quote|Luke was saved. But the struggle for freedom was not over yet. There would be new battles, and new challenges. And the Jedi would meet them all...|X2 after the victory on Mustafar|}} X2, Luke Skywalker, and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] troops returned to their frigate, preparing for all the challenges of the [[New Jedi Order]] and whatever else lay ahead. ==Behind the scenes== The DS version of the events played out a bit differently. In the DS version, it is implied that X1 reactivated the Separatist Droid facility on Mustafar for additional manpower, and that X2 had to open the door to the facility by activating a few switches. Also, the reference to cloning Luke Skywalker was cut, and as a result, the reason for X1 kidnapping Luke Skywalker was implied to just be out of pure spite. Also, Luke encourages X2 to fight X1 by himself as a test to his strength in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Also, X1 and X2 immediately battle with absolutely no aid from either side, meaning that the clone Wookiees and Stormtroopers aiding X1 in trying to defeat X2 was not in the DS version. Lastly, the final words between X2 and X1 were lengthened somewhat, namely on X1's part. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the battle of Mustafar (Galactic Civil War)}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Mustafar (Galaktischer Bürgerkrieg) |es=Batalla de Mustafar (Guerra Civil Galáctica) }} {{GCW 4 ABY 1}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Mustafar (Galactic Civil War), battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Mustafar]] [[Category:Battles of the Galactic Civil War]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
